<h2 align="center">From Concept to Completion — Engineering, Design, Software &amp; AI</h2>

I specialize in transforming ideas, technical concepts, and design requirements into complete, high-quality products. My expertise spans **3D engineering and manufacturing**, **full-stack software development**, **product and interface design**, and **practical AI integration**.

What sets this approach apart is connecting those disciplines into one cohesive development process. Engineering, design, software, and AI are not treated as separate tasks — they are brought together so the result is functional, technically sound, visually refined, and ready for real-world use.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **3D Engineering** | Digital modeling through machining, additive manufacturing, and finishing |
| **Full-Stack** | Interfaces, application logic, backend services, and AI-powered features |
| **Product Design** | Layout, materials, usability, and design-to-build implementation |
| **AI Integration** | Models wired into products so intelligence becomes a usable outcome |

## 3D Engineering & Digital Manufacturing

<p>
  <img src="3D.png" alt="A machined metal lattice on a fixture, with a luminous toolpath above it and a printed lattice beside it" width="100%" />
</p>

I work across the complete 3D production workflow — from digital modeling and geometric development to machining, additive manufacturing, and post-processing. Precision, practical engineering judgment, and production-aware design turn digital concepts into accurately manufactured physical components.

**Core capabilities:** 3D modeling · CAD development · CNC machining · additive manufacturing · toolpath planning · lattice structures · fixtures · post-processing

## Complete Solutions, Not Isolated Tasks

High-quality work comes from understanding the entire process and taking responsibility for how all its parts fit together.

Whether the project is a precision-manufactured component, a complete software application, an integrated AI system, or a combination of physical and digital technologies, the focus stays on the finished outcome — not only an individual stage.

Technical precision, thoughtful design, clear communication, and attention to detail matter throughout. Every element should serve a purpose, every component should work together, and the final result should meet the intended requirements.

**Commitment:** turn ideas into complete, well-engineered, thoughtfully designed, and fully functional results.
